purpose: P0-07 G0: freeze the independent candidate Decision Reviewer question and enumerate all unresolved G1 permits; this artifact is NOT a provider request, source rights grant, production activation, or success certificate.

review_question.scope: Separate shadow opinion on an authentic ENTRY_CANDIDATE using contemporaneously available and explicitly permitted structured quant facts only.
review_question.question: Do the approved contemporaneous quant facts support keeping this already returned entry candidate (PASS_THROUGH), reveal a material reason requiring human reconsideration (REVIEW_REQUIRED), or fail to justify a determinate review (ABSTAIN)?
review_question.hypothesis: On the same authentic candidates, the independent CHOICE review may identify beneficial reconsiderations not already captured by the baseline without excessive missed winning opportunities, latency, errors, or cost.
review_question.falsification: After eligible prospective cohort maturity under a pre-frozen evaluation policy, nonpositive incremental return per opportunity, missed gains at least as large as avoided losses, worsening retained-candidate loss rate, or violated safety/operational gates reject limited adoption; insufficient sample or unresolved contracts => HOLD rather than performance rejection.
review_question.model_output_limit: TypeSafe CHOICE returns choice/confidence/probabilities/usage. No generated evidence citation or natural-language reason can be assumed.
review_question.app_authored_explanations: If an explanation is constructed from source evidence, label it as application-authored, not provider-authored.
